title: You are finished
drDigitalIntro:
That is the whole course. Thirteen units, and a final assessment you completed without being shown where to click.
• You can move, resize and close a window; find, rename and rescue a file; browse without being caught out.
• You can write an email with a subject line that means something, and spot the one that is a scam.
• You can install an app and read what it asks for first, join a public network safely, and set a screen up for your own eyes.
• Most importantly: you know that almost nothing on a computer is permanent, and that the control which made a change is the control that undoes it.
• Go and do all of it on your own computer. That was always the point.
drDigitalSuccess: You have finished LearnAComputer. Nothing on that machine is beyond you now — and when something is new, it will still be a window, a menu and a button.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then go and use your computer.
